scope: UIUC / Champaign–Urbana; navigation and preparation only
translation: Chinese text is a project translation, not an official translation.

steps.body_en: Review official descriptions of primary care, walk-in care, and emergency departments. These labels describe services; this guide does not choose a care level from symptoms.
steps.body_zh: 查看官方对 primary care、walk-in care 和 emergency department 的说明。本指南解释服务类型，不根据症状判断应去哪类机构。

sources.title: Get Care
sources.locator: Care types; CARE line; patient information line

steps.title_en: Ask a healthcare professional when unsure
steps.title_zh: 不确定时咨询医疗人员
steps.body_en: McKinley lists a 24/7 nurse phone service at 217-333-2700. Ask whether you are eligible to use it.
steps.body_zh: McKinley 公布了 24/7 护士电话服务：217-333-2700。请确认自己是否有资格使用。

sources.publisher: University of Illinois McKinley Health Center
sources.title: Dial-a-Nurse
sources.review_method: Primary-source desk review; English/Chinese wording checked in this project

steps.title_en: Start with your existing follow-up instructions
steps.body_en: Use the follow-up instructions from your treating clinician. Contact that team to clarify the next visit and which specialist to contact. This guide does not set a treatment timetable.
steps.body_zh: 先查看治疗医生提供的 follow-up instructions；向原治疗团队确认下一次就诊和应联系的专科。本指南不设定治疗或复诊时间。

sources.title: Be Prepared for Your Visit, Step 6
sources.anchors: Insurance card|Photo identification|Do I need a referral

steps.body_en: Use your insurance documents or contact your insurer to identify the plan and its provider directory. An insurer name alone is not enough to confirm a provider network.
steps.body_zh: 查看保险文件或联系保险公司，确认具体 plan 及 provider directory。仅知道保险公司名称，不足以确认医生属于哪个网络。

sources.title: Getting regular medical care
sources.locator: Finding a doctor in your plan
sources.review_method: Primary-source desk review; English/Chinese wording checked in this project

steps.title_en: Check the provider, location, and plan together
steps.title_zh: 同时核实医生、地点和保险计划
steps.body_en: Check your plan directory and confirm with the insurer and office. Ask about the named clinician and visit location. Network participation is separate from coverage of a particular service.
steps.body_zh: 查看计划目录，并向保险公司和诊所确认具体医生与就诊地点。属于网络内，不等于某项服务一定获得 coverage。

sources.title: Getting regular medical care
sources.locator: Finding a doctor in your plan
sources.review_method: Primary-source desk review; English/Chinese wording checked in this project

steps.title_en: Ask whether a referral is needed
steps.body_en: Ask the insurer and specialist office whether this visit requires a referral. A referral is an order to see a specialist or receive certain services; requirements vary.
steps.body_zh: 向保险公司与专科诊所确认这次就诊是否需要 referral。Referral 是转诊至专科或某些服务的医嘱；要求会因情况而异。

sources.title: Referral
sources.review_method: Primary-source desk review; English/Chinese wording checked in this project

steps.title_en: Ask about prior authorization for planned services
steps.title_zh: 询问计划中的服务是否需要预授权
steps.body_en: For planned services, ask whether prior authorization is required and who submits it. Preauthorization is not a promise that the plan will cover the cost.
steps.body_zh: 对于计划中的服务，询问是否需要 prior authorization，以及由谁申请。获得预授权不代表保险一定支付费用。

sources.title: Preauthorization
sources.review_method: Primary-source desk review; English/Chinese wording checked in this project

steps.title_en: Ask what costs remain your responsibility
steps.body_en: Ask your insurer how the deductible and other cost sharing apply to the planned visit. This project does not estimate a final bill.
steps.body_zh: 向保险公司询问 deductible 和其他费用分担如何适用于这次就诊。本项目不估算最终账单。

sources.title: Deductible
sources.review_method: Primary-source desk review; English/Chinese wording checked in this project

steps.title_en: Confirm the booking route and availability
steps.title_zh: 确认预约方式和是否接诊
steps.body_en: Use the official care entry or office contact. Say whether you are a new patient and explain the visit purpose. Ask whether that visit type can be booked online.
steps.body_zh: 使用官方就医入口或联系办公室。说明是否为新患者以及就诊目的；确认该类就诊是否能在线预约。

steps.title_en: Request an interpreter ahead of time
steps.body_en: Call the office before the visit to request an interpreter. Confirm arrangements; this project does not assume every location has the same language services.
steps.body_zh: 就诊前联系办公室申请 interpreter，并确认安排。本项目不假设每个地点提供相同的语言服务。

steps.title_en: Ask how to transfer existing records
steps.title_zh: 询问如何提交已有病历
steps.body_en: Ask the receiving office which existing records it needs and how to send them. McKinley uses an authorization process for record requests; allow time for processing.
steps.body_zh: 向接收诊所确认需要哪些已有病历及提交方式。McKinley 申请病历需要授权流程，应留出处理时间。

steps.body_en: Bring available insurance documentation, photo identification, and any requested forms. Ask the office about payment requirements.
steps.body_zh: 准备已有保险凭证、带照片的身份证明及诊所要求的表格，并确认付款要求。

steps.body_en: Make a list of medicines, supplements, allergies, and questions. Keep the list with you rather than entering personal medical details into this demo.
steps.body_zh: 整理药物、补充剂、过敏情况和问题清单。自行携带，不需要在本演示中输入个人医疗详情。

sources.review_method: Primary-source desk review; English/Chinese wording checked in this project

steps.title_en: Write down questions and take notes
steps.body_en: Prepare the questions you want to discuss. During the visit, take notes and ask for clarification when an explanation is unclear.
steps.body_zh: 提前写下想讨论的问题；就诊时记录回答，听不明白时要求解释。

sources.title: Talking With Your Doctor
sources.review_method: Primary-source desk review; English/Chinese wording checked in this project

steps.title_en: Confirm what happens after the visit
steps.body_en: Ask for written next steps, the timing of any follow-up, and whom to contact with questions. Follow the treating clinician's instructions.
steps.body_zh: 询问书面的后续步骤、复诊安排，以及有问题时联系谁；遵循治疗医生的要求。

office_questions: I'm a new patient arranging a visit. Do you accept new patients, and how should I book?
Which clinician and location will I see? Which documents or prior records should I bring?
I was already treated for a fracture and am arranging follow-up. Do I need a referral, and how should my existing records be sent?
Could you arrange a Mandarin interpreter? Please confirm how this will work for my appointment.
insurer_questions: My exact plan and network are [plan/network]. Is [clinician] at [location] in this network?
For the planned service [service], what coverage conditions, referral requirements, or prior authorization apply?
What deductible or other cost sharing may apply? Can you provide a reference number for this conversation?
script_note: Project-written question templates. They ask for confirmation and do not state provider or insurer requirements.
